title: SVP at Global IT Services Firm Sees Samsara Gaining Share and Expects 12%–20% Business Growth in 2026
expert: SVP at a global IT services firm advising asset-intensive enterprise customers on Samsara (telemetry, AI video safety, asset monitoring)
verdict: The expert's Samsara-related business grew 5%–10% y/y in Aug–Oct 2026, led by existing-customer expansion while new enterprise logos came in below plan.

Enterprise expansion ($100K+ cohort): 🟡 Samsara business +5%–10% y/y in Aug–Oct, vs 2026-11-05 partner reads of +20%–22% (telco channel) and ~25% (VAR): lower. → Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion) ↓
🟢 Renewal spend +6%–15% (estimate) as fleets add cameras and modules; expansion is 45%–55% of pipeline, in line with core NRR ~115% (SB #62603). → Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion) ↑
🔴 New enterprise logos below plan in Aug–Oct; first read on new-logo conversion. → Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion) ↓
GM/FCF through component cycle: 🔴 Effective negotiated pricing down 0%–5% (estimate) on bundling, vs 2026-11-05 calls at +5%–7% (platform) and +10%–12%: conflicting. → Tenet 3 (op leverage vs hardware cost) ↓
Competition & share: 🟢 Samsara and Motive gaining, Verizon Connect under pressure; matches the 2026-11-05 Verizon Connect director (Samsara in 85%–90% of deals). → Tenet 4 (platform moat) ↑

characterization_changed: Positive: the expert's own Samsara business grew only 5%–10% with new logos below plan and effective pricing down 0%–5%.
changes: Growth: practice +5%–10% vs 2026-11-05 partner calls at +20%–22% (telco channel) and ~25% (VAR): lower.
Pricing: effective pricing down 0%–5% vs 2026-11-05 calls at +5%–7% for platform deals and +10%–12%: conflicting.
Share: Samsara and Motive gaining, Verizon Connect pressured vs 2026-11-05 Verizon Connect director (85%–90% deal presence): consistent.
Mix: pipeline 45%–55% expansion vs core NRR ~115% (SB #62603): consistent with expansion-led growth.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion): → — renewal spend +6%–15% and an expansion-heavy pipeline vs new logos below plan and only 5%–10% practice growth.
Tenet 3 (op leverage vs hardware cost): ↓ — effective pricing down 0%–5% on bundling.
Tenet 4 (platform moat): ↑ — integrated platform wins multi-product deals; Verizon Connect losing.
Tenet 5 (Street FY28 too low): → — practice outlook 12%–20% for CY26 (estimate).
